checkpoints.summary: Derive the phone pocket from measured envelope dimensions and one named per-side clearance.
Add a rim, compliant button pads, inner button relief, and a named eyelet bore.
Teachable procedural cell grid derived from iphone-17e-cell-grid.ecky. The final ~230-strut data graph is a static edge fixture, not procedural Voronoi.
Map camera coordinates from the phone datum and form the TPU support around the measured cluster.
Inner PETG island uses named seat clearance and capture thickness.
Complete the outer PETG snap island with named interference and generated relief slots.
Exact landing reference: TPU case plus inner and outer PETG islands. Static ~230-strut edge data is a fixed fixture, never procedural Voronoi.
Hénon opening and Lorenz sweep guide: executable point-list helpers, not a phone-case production part.
Cellular wall-pattern checkpoint rendered natively; sampled surface result is not claimed as an analytic primitive.
